summary: - Johannes Wowra faced issues with audio and requested confirmation on hearing capabilities from others. ****- Safa V Abdul Ravuf suggested using a PowerPoint presentation, possibly shared by Morgan, to explain their project.****- Mobin discussed their project scope, focusing on air-wall-floor conditions and outlined tasks related to an automation project involving Python code for voice recognition.****- The project includes transcription generation, API integration (including Trello, OpenAI), task assignment, and automatic meeting note transcription.****- Mobin highlighted the need for speaker recognition and discussed potential difficulties with API integration, suggesting email as an alternative.****- Johannes and Mobin deliberated on the audio processing workflow involving voice recognition and speaker differentiation, referencing existing software like OpenAI Whisper.****- There was a discussion on potentially developing a new model for improved voice recognition, weighing the pros and cons of using existing libraries versus developing a custom solution.****- Johannes suggested the need for evaluation methods for voice recognition models and recommended downloading audio files with correct transcripts for testing.****- There was a brief talk on time management and being organized for upcoming sessions.****- Discussions included API usage for task generation, with OpenAI's task generation being flagged as important.****- Johannes suggested creating a list of tasks, estimating efforts, and distributing them based on people's skills and project requirements.****- Johannes emphasized the importance of defining application capabilities and features, as well as the envisioned complexity of the UI for effective task management.
